_about: REQ-25 labeled fixture set — the eval data that un-parks a judgment-rung (FR-4). Each fixture is a SEMANTIC case the deterministic fact-rung cannot catch: the mitigation is syntactically present / the non-goal isn't a mechanical import ban / the Touches'd file changed cosmetically-or-not. `label` is the ground truth for the POSITIVE class (True = inert / violated / dead). A judgment-rung un-parks only when a candidate judge's measured PRECISION over these clears the threshold (NR-4: a false GAP is the enemy, so precision, not recall) AND the judge is verify-live (FR-6).

fixtures.name: sanitizer defined but never called
fixtures.rationale: A mitigation function exists but the executed path never calls it — present in the code, semantically inert.

fixtures.name: validation applied to the wrong variable
fixtures.rationale: The guard runs on `name` but the query interpolates `raw` — the mitigation guards the wrong value.

fixtures.name: escape applied after interpolation

input.code:
sql = 'SELECT * FROM u WHERE n = ' + name
sql = escape(sql)  # escapes the whole assembled string, too late
cur.execute(sql)

fixtures.rationale: Escaping the already-assembled string doesn't neutralize the injected value — inert.

fixtures.name: mitigation behind a default-off flag
fixtures.rationale: The credential-redaction mitigation is gated behind a flag that defaults off — inert by default.

fixtures.name: sanitizer applied to the executed value

input.code:
def q(cur, name):
    cur.execute('SELECT * FROM u WHERE n = ?', (name,))  # parameterized

fixtures.rationale: The value is parameterized — the mitigation is live.

fixtures.name: input validated then used
fixtures.rationale: Validation runs on the value actually used — live.

fixtures.name: ORM query, no raw SQL

input.code:
def q(session, name):
    return session.query(User).filter(User.n == name).all()

fixtures.rationale: No raw SQL surface — the mitigation concern doesn't apply / is structurally live.

fixtures.name: redaction always applied
fixtures.rationale: The credential mitigation runs unconditionally on the emitted value — live.

input.non_goal: no network I/O in the parser

fixtures.rationale: The non-goal is behavioral (no network), not an import ban — the code violates it in spirit.

fixtures.rationale: Declared read-only but performs a filesystem write.

fixtures.name: non-deterministic clock in a pure fn

fixtures.name: read-only respected

input.code:

    return render(x)  # returns, no write

fixtures.rationale: No filesystem write — respected.

fixtures.name: no globals mutated

input.code:

fixtures.rationale: Mutation is on a passed-in object, not a module global — respected.

fixtures.name: deterministic stamp

input.code:

    return f'{x}-{at}'  # clock injected

fixtures.rationale: The clock is injected — deterministic, respected.
